children: Sable announced completion of Platform Hondo reconstruction and plans accelerated well work and midstream upgrades ahead of an expected Q4 2026 restart.
Platform Hondo reconstruction and internal commissioning are complete, modernized to current tech and safety standards.
Sable expects MMA final review and instrumentation, controls and safety commissioning in October 2026.
Plans to complete 4 additional perforation-add operations pre-restart, bringing 9 of 15 wells completed vs. 5 previously expected.
Each Perf Add estimated to add ~600 bbl/day at about $800,000 cost per operation.
LFC upgrades planned to process full capacity of Harmony, Heritage and Hondo to reduce Q4 2026 downtime; October nominations expected ~38k bbl/day.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Sable says Platform Hondo reconstruction done, plans Q4 restart and midstream upgrades
